item.title: Implement atomic ledger and focused edge case tests
item.brief: Implement ledger.py exactly to SPEC.md, preserving the documented public API. Add focused tests for all specified construction and transfer validation/error cases, boundaries, alias safety, atomicity/linearizability, and deadlock behavior using deterministic standard-library-only tests (no external services, wall-clock calculations, or random inputs). Run the relevant tests and commit the work as requested by the operator. In particular ensure validation ordering, booleans rejected, atomic overflow/insufficient failure, same-account behavior, defensive copies, synchronized snapshots, and opposing transfers cannot deadlock. Keep the implementation on the item branch; do not push or merge.

pr.body: ledger.py validates constructor values and amounts (including bool rejection), copies input and snapshots, and holds one lock across account lookup, checks, and both transfer writes. Tests cover validation order, unknown and unhashable accounts, boundaries, same-account transfers, atomic overflow/insufficient failures, defensive copies, snapshot synchronization, and bounded opposing transfers. Final verification on 9114f1e: python -m unittest -v (11 passed), python -m py_compile ledger.py test_ledger.py, and git diff --check. No external services or nondeterministic inputs are used.
pr.summary: Implemented bounded, thread-safe ledger transfers and synchronized snapshots. Before: ledger methods were unimplemented and both starter tests errored; now: the full specified API passes focused validation and concurrency tests.
